title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial for the health of both mother and baby. However, with busy lives, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that provide a balanced mix of protein, fiber, and calcium for pregnant women.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are selected to provide adequate protein, fiber, and calcium for pregnant women. Protein helps build and repair body tissues, fiber supports digestive health, and calcium helps develop bones and teeth for the baby.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Potato Soup
Chicken and potato soup is a nutritious and easy-to-make meal. Pregnant women can add various vegetables like carrots, onions, and celery to increase the fiber content.

### 2. Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
Beef and broccoli stir-fry is a protein-rich and fiber-rich meal. Pregnant women should choose lean beef and fresh broccoli to ensure nutrition.

### 3. Fried Egg with Salad
Fried egg with salad is a great option for dinner. Eggs provide protein and vitamins, while salads provide fiber and vitamins.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a light and nutritious meal. Yogurt provides calcium and protein, while fruit provides vitamins and fiber.

### 5. Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
Chicken and vegetable fried rice is a balanced meal. Pregnant women can add various vegetables like green beans, carrots, and celery to increase the fiber content.

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety, pregnant women should:
* Wash hands before preparing meals
* Wash vegetables and fruits before using
* Cook meat and eggs before eating
* Avoid eating undercooked or expired food

Pregnant women can also refer to our [meal planner](/planner) for daily meal suggestions.

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women experience any signs of food poisoning or other health issues, they should seek medical help immediately.
